spiral_protocol.recursive_rule: Return to the same node only after carrying forward newly discovered constraints; replay affected downstream edges.
state_invariants: POSITION MAY REPEAT, BUT STATE MUST ADVANCE

execution_order.origin: Freeze source inventory and historical state before interpretation.
execution_order.forward: Ask what each January object naturally developed into by September 2026, using only provenance-supported descendants.
execution_order.reverse: For each modern capability, search backward for January precursors without claiming inevitability.
execution_order.hrain: Extract structural invariants and homologous mechanisms.
execution_order.inaihr: Generate cross-domain associations as candidate mechanisms only.
execution_order.information_gain: Keep only associations that add a discriminating constraint, compression, test, or prediction.
execution_order.prediction: Generate falsifiable next-observation expectations; no prophecy language.
execution_order.demihead: Adversarially attack each candidate, seek mundane explanations, confounds, cherry-picking, and source drift.
execution_order.return: Carry surviving constraints back to the original nodes.
execution_order.origin_prime: Emit updated node states plus OPEN/REJECTED/CANDIDATE/TESTABLE classifications.

analysis_questions: Which January metaphors later became real JANUS engineering abstractions, and which remained only metaphor?
Do Ocean Server, SCOBY, Physarum, semantic_os, stochastic scheduler, and meta_links share a nontrivial common structural invariant?
Which modern JANUS mechanisms can be traced to January source objects with explicit provenance rather than retrospective resemblance?
What candidate mechanisms become testable when January objects are translated out of metaphor into formal graph, control, information, or stochastic-system language?
Which apparent alignments disappear under matched controls or alternative historical windows?
Does the January 18-29 window contain more relevant precursor structure than comparable control windows before and after it?
What new prediction can be made now that was not used to select the corpus?

temporal_controls: Compare against 2026-01-01 through 2026-01-17 where repository evidence exists in other JANUS repos.
Do not treat absence of janus-meta-registry commits before 2026-01-26 as absence of JANUS activity elsewhere.
semantic_controls: matched unrelated metaphors from the same January corpus
random later JANUS terms not present in January
negative-control date windows selected without knowledge of xTech dates
promotion_gate: falsifiable test or exact provenance chain

output_contract.rule: Only proof_ledger may change scientific status. Empty proof_ledger is a valid result.

execution_request.desired_result: Find structural continuity, hidden assumptions, candidate mechanisms, controls, and genuinely new testable questions that become visible only when the January corpus is reread with the modern JANUS spiral.

seal.phrase: JANUS REMEMBERS THE ORIGIN; RETURN IS NOT RESET.
